# LoonaFlow AI

LoonaFlow AI is a web-based B2B lead generation and outreach automation platform. It helps teams find local business leads by niche or country, create personalized cold email campaigns, and track replies from one dashboard.

Website: https://loonaflow.app
Contact: hello@loonaflow.app
Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/loonaflow-ai

## Product Summary

Key features include business scraping by niche and location, CSV lead upload as an alternative to scraping, AI-powered email personalization, campaign creation, reply tracking, lead management, analytics, email templates, and self-serve subscription management (including cancellation).

Primary audiences include marketing agencies, sales teams, founders, freelancers, small businesses, and business development professionals.
